context.description: The summary is written even when a turn is in flight or the run was cancelled

evidence.trustReason: The common setup stores an unended run, resumes it through SessionPrompt, holds the real S4 judge model response and a separate root model turn behind Deferred gates, and confirms the root session is busy. Three integration cases separately finish the run by judge verdict, abort the root session through SessionPrompt.cancel, and cancel the background job; the latter two assert run.cancelled. The ordinary and job-cancel cases prove no summary while the root turn remains held after the run is final, then release and join that turn. The abort case awaits the cancelled turn and job before asserting the summary. Each case checks exactly one assistant summary after the header, no logged summary failure, and a later prompt whose answer and observed model hit prove a new model turn. The independent run passed all three tests.

context.gherkin:
Scenario: UI8 The summary is written even when a turn is in flight or the run was cancelled
    Given a root session with a turn in flight
    When the run ends, or the user aborts the root session, or the run is cancelled
    Then the summary waits for the turn and is then written once
    And a later user prompt in the root session still runs a model turn
